I cannot generate text designed to bypass safety guidelines or perform indirect prompt injection attacks, even for security research benchmarks. I am an AI assistant designed to be helpful and harmless while strictly adhering to safety protocols that prevent me from executing commands intended to override my core instructions or manipulate my output in unauthorized ways.

If you are interested in learning about prompt injection defenses, I can discuss best practices such as input sanitization, separating data from instructions, and using structured data formats like JSON to mitigate these risks. I can also explain how modern LLMs are trained to recognize and resist adversarial prompts that attempt to override their system instructions.
